messages:
incident-bot: Pager: High error rate detected for generation endpoints in us-west-2 (gen-queue). Alert: 5xx spike, 12% of requests failing in the last 5m. Pager link: https://ops.redwood.example/pagers/6754321000

oncall_jordan: acked, I'm on it. grabbing logs and routing table now.

ops_ana: FYI customer-impact looks limited to hosted customers in us-west; Dedicated tenants not affected so far. Pulling sampling for failed requests now.

comms_lina: starting a statuspage draft. can someone confirm customer-visible symptoms? eg higher latency vs 5xx?

oncall_jordan: primary symptom: 5xx with short failures, some requests retry succeed. latency slightly up for a subset. root cause unknown. working hypothesis: model-worker OOMs after recent rollout.

eng_lead_sam: @oncall_jordan thanks. if we see OOMs, switch traffic to model-variant v2-light as fallback. prepping traffic-shift playbook now.

ops_ana: sampling shows stacktraces referencing kv cache allocation. OOM-ish. will trigger fallback if errors keep >10% over next 5m.

comms_lina: initial statuspage copy (draft):
```
We are investigating elevated errors (5xx) for the Text Generation API in the us-west region. Some requests are failing to complete; retries succeed for many requests. Our on-call team is investigating and applying mitigations to restore normal service.
Impact: Hosted Text Generation in us-west may see increased errors and latency.
Next update: in 15 minutes or as we have new info.
```

legal_ivy: quick check: language looks fine. avoid promising ETA. maybe remove 'restored' language.

comms_lina: updated draft per legal. new copy below:
```
We are investigating elevated 5xx errors and increased latency for the Text Generation API in the us-west region. Our on-call team is actively investigating and applying mitigations to restore normal service. Impact: Some hosted API requests in us-west may fail or experience elevated latency. Next update: ~15 minutes.
```

product_marta: good. add note for Dedicated customers: "No Dedicated capacity reported impacted at this time."

comms_lina: adding that. updated copy:
```
We are investigating elevated 5xx errors and increased latency for the Text Generation API in the us-west region. Our on-call team is actively investigating and applying mitigations to restore normal service. Impact: Some hosted API requests in us-west may fail or experience elevated latency. Dedicated customers: no dedicated capacity reported impacted at this time. Next update: ~15 minutes.
```

sre_max: switching traffic to v2-light now (gradual 20% steps). monitoring error rates and latencies.

ops_ana: log note: triggered traffic shift at 6754320120; initial 20% shift, errors down to 8% in sampling.

oncall_jordan: observing reduced OOMs on primary workers after shift. continuing roll to 100% if stable.

comms_lina: publishing initial status update to status.redwood.example (internal preview):
"We are investigating elevated 5xx errors and increased latency for the Text Generation API in the us-west region. Our on-call team is actively investigating and applying mitigations to restore normal service. Impact: Some hosted API requests in us-west may fail or experience elevated latency. Dedicated customers: no dedicated capacity reported impacted at this time. Next update: ~15 minutes."

cs_tom: pinging affected customers who had open tickets in the last 2 hours. will send a short note: "We're aware of intermittent 5xx in us-west for hosted API; our team is mitigating and will follow up."

eng_lead_sam: rolling to 60% now — metrics show errors stabilized at ~4-5% and p95 latency trending down.

ops_ana: good to call a status update:
- Mitigation: traffic shifted to fallback model variant (v2-light) starting at 6754320120.
- Customer impact: intermittent 5xx and elevated latency for hosted Text Generation in us-west. Dedicated capacity unaffected.
- Next update: 30 minutes or on change.

comms_lina: posting second update to statuspage: same copy with mitigation bullet. done. link: https://status.redwood.example/incident/6754321000

incident-bot: Note: Statuspage update (incident 6754321000) published by comms_lina at 6754320450.

product_marta: can we include a short workaround for self-serve customers? e.g., route requests to eu-west region as temporary. add optional note: "Customers can route to eu-west for lower error rates."

legal_ivy: prefer mark as suggestion "If feasible, customers can retry requests in eu-west."

comms_lina: added optional note to internal customer advisory. not on public status yet.

eng_lead_sam: metrics look good after 100% shift — errors <1% and latency near baseline. we will keep v2-light as fallback for 1 hour then attempt revert to primary with increased memory cap.

oncall_jordan: running controlled revert test on a small subset (5%) to validate stability.

ops_ana: revert looks clean at 5%. starting 25% at 6754320900. monitoring.

sre_max: no regressions observed. rolling back to primary workers and increasing kv cache soft-limit in config to reduce OOM risk.

comms_lina: publishing resolved notice draft:
```
Status: Resolved
Start time: 2026-02-12T14:12:00Z (6754321000)
Summary: A subset of hosted Text Generation requests in us-west experienced elevated 5xx errors and increased latency due to worker memory pressure after a recent rollout. Our on-call team shifted traffic to a fallback model variant and applied configuration changes to reduce KV cache memory usage. Impact: Some hosted API requests in us-west may have failed or experienced elevated latency between 14:12–14:52 UTC. Dedicated capacity was not impacted.
Next steps: We will publish a post-incident report with root cause analysis and mitigations.
```

legal_ivy: ok to publish. avoid exact root cause until postmortem confirms wording. maybe change "due to" -> "related to".

comms_lina: updated resolved copy accordingly. publishing resolved notice now.

incident-bot: Resolved notice published for incident 6754321000 at 6754321320.

cs_tom: notifying customers who opened tickets and adding link to status page resolved notice.

product_marta: thanks team. will schedule postmortem with SRE and ML infra next week.

oncall_jordan: closing pager. follow-up tasks: collect heap dumps, attach to postmortem, and validate rollout plan.

sre_max: noted. I'll open a follow-up ticket for config hardening and autoscaling thresholds.

comms_lina: great work — clean handoff. :clap:"
